texto: Ask: "Where is it?" Answer with a position word: "It is under the table."
lastro: preposicoes.jpg: UNDER, 'The ball is under the table'; sala.jpg 'two dogs under the table'. PT ok.

texto: Hold up your two hands, palms away from you. Your left hand makes the letter L.
lastro: Verdadeiro: mao esquerda, palma para a frente, indicador para cima e polegar para a direita desenha L (a direita faz L espelhado). Coerente com a licao left/right (mapa.jpg). Truque de apoio, nao conteudo cobrado. PT ok.

texto: One thing, different positions, different views.
lastro: perspectiva.jpg: 'We can see many things from different positions, and our perspective changes...'. PT ok.

texto: The same force can help or hurt. Wind spreads the seeds: helpful. Strong winds: harmful.
lastro: agua-vento.jpg: wind and water are natural forces, harmful and helpful; 'Wind that spread the seeds' helpful; 'Strong winds' harmful. PT ok.

texto: How does it move? Say the movement (roll, spin...), the direction (up and down...) and the speed (slow or fast).
lastro: objetos.jpg (roll, spin, bounce=up and down); direcoes e velocidade (slow or fast) vem do video V1 (_roteiro O7/O8) e sao verdadeiras por si. PT ok.

texto: Ask: is it going away from me? It is a push. Is it coming closer to me? It is a pull.
lastro: push-pull.jpg: push = away from me, pull = closer to me. PT ok.
Contexto "in the water" fecha em swims (corpo-mao.jpg swim; V1). "jumps in the water" so valeria para quem salta PARA a agua, leitura forcada. PT "O peixe nada na agua" ok. Reavaliado apos correcao.
"in the sky" so aceita flies; jumps/climbs/crawls/swims nao cabem no ceu. PT ok. Reavaliado.

climbs e a colocacao natural (climb em corpo-mao.jpg). "jumps up the tree" e possivel mas forcado, e o canguru so aceita jumps, fechando a atribuicao. Ressalva baixa, nao bloqueia. PT "sobe na arvore" ok. Reavaliado.
Unica do banco que serve (canguru nao voa, escala nem rasteja). PT ok.

onde: arrasta animais: A snake ___ on the ground.
lastro: 'on the ground' exclui swims/flies/jumps/climbs. PT ok.
